limitations: Scope times overlap and are not additive frame costs.
Opt-in nanosecond scopes perturb scheduling; compare profile-on and profile-off timing.
Allocation scopes exclude destruction. Queue-lock scopes cover public submit paths, not all window locks.
CUDA API scopes measure host-call duration, not PCIe transfer duration or exclusive device computation.
Shared records are rebuilt within each batch; scene-wide GPU residency and dependency-index integration are not implemented by this test.
No multiworker, arbitrary-material, production-scene or full-parity claim.
